edition.headline: Claude Code reads AGENTS.md, DeepSeek shrinks KV cache, skills get scanned, and more
edition.dek: The day is mostly about the plumbing around coding agents: shared instruction files, skill scanning, harness studies and cheaper long context. Few items are new model capabilities, and most evidence is reported rather than reproduced.
edition.note: Rebuilt from archives: the YouTube Intel Brief, the archived GitHub trending page, Hacker News, Hugging Face papers and the feeds that still list that day. X, live star counts and trending models are not recoverable for past days.
